body:
## Summary

Fixes #1558

The merge of #1563 (the #1558 implementation) and #1569 (#1487 statement identity) left `main` red. This PR restores every main gate those merges broke.

### 1. The Rust crate compiles again (`E0308`)
`ProofOutcome::confidence` (added for #1487 in `rust/src/proof_engine/types.rs`) returned `f64`. Its only caller passes that value to `finalize_simple`, which takes `f32`. So every Rust lane on `main` failed with:

```
error[E0308]: mismatched types
  --> rust/src/solver_handlers/user_intent.rs:141
```

It now returns `f32`, the type the `match` it replaced used to infer. The `E0308` failed these on `main` (686367d20), and the fix unblocks all of them:
- doc tests
- *Build binaries and tests*
- lint lanes 1–4
- the scheduled *Task Ladder* and *Write-Effect Ladder* workflows

### 2. tests-as-docs gate (R234-2)
The gate rejected `negated_theorem_request_is_refuted_never_proven` (`rust/tests/unit/proof_request.rs`) because it had no exact-answer assertion. It now pins the full refutation answer with `assert_eq!(response.answer, "…")`. I checked `scripts/check-tests-as-docs.rs` on both trees: it fails on the base tree and passes with this change.

### 3. JS/Rust parity for Euclid proof requests (#1487)
Pinning the exact native answer showed that the JavaScript worker disagreed with it in two ways:
- **Refutation.** "Prove there are not infinitely many primes." embedded the positive theorem's `Proof (method: contradiction).` block, which the native test forbids.
- **Affirmed proof.** It was a hand-written copy for each language, without step labels.

Both are now rendered from the seeded theorem (`proofLibraryTheoremProof`) with the shared presenter helpers. The refutation is a `Disproof` with labelled steps and the native clarifying-question footer (`proofPresenterDisprovenFollowUps`), byte-identical to `render_disproven` plus `enforce_questions`.

`rust/tests/web/issue-1487-proposition-identity.test.mjs` pins both exact answers. It also asserts that no negated request (EN/ZH) carries a `Proof (` / `证明 (` heading.

Supporting changes:
- The TS twins are regenerated with `scripts/translate-es.mjs --write`.
- Worker line budget for `formal_ai_worker_calendar_and_proofs`: 1208 → 1146.
- JS literal ratchet `worker-ceiling`: 429 → 416. Both numbers only fall.

### 4. Merge reconciliation
- Adopted main's fixture layout (`rust/tests/fixtures/`) and module order.
- Dropped the duplicate `mod` declaration the merge produced.

### Experiments / tooling
- `experiments/issue-1558/rust-module-harness/` compiles the unchanged `rust/src/agentic_coding/work_item_references.rs` and its unit tests on their own (9/9 pass), without building the whole crate.
- `experiments/plan-event-append-race/stress.sh` investigates the intermittent `simultaneous retries take the bounded lock and retain exactly one event` failure on main. It did not reproduce in 0/1,500 concurrent runs, so no code change is made for it.
- `experiments/issue-1558/negated-theorem-answer.mjs` prints the worker's intent, answer and evidence for a prompt.

### Out of scope
- `dependencies-latest` fails on main because of about 50 upstream dependency bumps. That failure has nothing to do with #1558/#1487 and existed before them.

### Caveat
PR CI does not compile Rust; only `main` does. The native assertions are therefore checked by `cargo check`/`rustfmt` locally and by the byte-identical JavaScript answer. They are exercised in full by the main pipeline after merge.

## Verification (local)
- `node --test rust/tests/web/issue-1487-proposition-identity.test.mjs`: 10/10 pass.
- `rust-script scripts/check-tests-as-docs.rs` (built as a cargo project): fails on the base tree, passes here.
- `node scripts/translate-es.mjs --check`, `check-js-literals`, and the worker line-budget gate pass.
- `cargo fmt --check` passes, and `cargo check --test unit` compiles the unit test target (including the new `assert_eq!`) with no errors or warnings.
- `experiments/issue-1558/rust-module-harness`: `cargo test` 9/9.
- `experiments/plan-event-append-race/stress.sh`: 0 duplicates in 1,500 runs.
title: fix(ci): restore the main gates broken by the #1558/#1487 merges (f32 confidence, tests-as-docs, Euclid JS/Rust parity)

## Summary

The issue sets its own scope: "We scope of this issue is documentation and issues planing, so the result here should be documentation changes and issues created/organized". This pull request delivers exactly that: an audit of the vision against the source, the corrected documents, a case study, and the issues created and organized on GitHub. It changes no source file and no version.

Fixes https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/1548

**Who wrote this.** Formal AI was asked first, as CONTRIBUTING requires. Its session on this pull request ended with "Planificado, no ejecutado" (terminal state `planned_not_executed`, [comment](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/1549#issuecomment-6760365706)) and made no change; that failed ask is retained and counted in section 5 of the case study. Everything after the three development-log commits of that session was written by a Hive Mind session of another model, not by Formal AI.

## What we do most wrong (measured at `70935ad8e`, v0.355.34)

The full audit with file and line for each statement is `docs/case-studies/issue-1548/raw-data/audit/vision-vs-code.md`; the summary is section 3 of [the case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/issue-1548-592fb16cb273/docs/case-studies/issue-1548/README.md).

1. The universal problem-solving loop of the vision picture is not the procedure that produces answers. The eleven steps are recorded as events, while the answer of most prompts comes from a handler selected by the formalized intent. The one general attempt, split and recompose procedure (`rust/src/recursive_execution.rs`) has one caller, used when work is delegated to an external agent. The coding ladder records 23 of 130 tasks.
2. No draft of Formal AI on a real issue has left a retained change: 19 pull requests in this repository and 133 in link-assistant/hive-mind, 0 files other than logs.
3. Documents said "Built" or "Implemented" for capabilities the source does not have. Those sentences are corrected here.

## Issues created and organized

- **Parent of all critical blockers:** [#1561](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/1561) — 31 sub-issues and 17 native `blocked by` relations to blockers that already had another parent (GitHub allows one parent per issue). The body gives the order of work in five stages, the requirement of #1548 each issue carries, and what advances each class of failed attempt.
- **13 issues created:** #1550 to #1556 (capabilities the vision requires and no issue carried: recursive execution of the loop as the default path, test-first selection of a candidate, relative meta logic for scoring options and inferring missing statements, licence-aware reuse of source code, replacement of stored solutions, general question answering through discovery, switches between valid options), #1557 to #1560 and #1562 (defects that end a draft in its first minute), and #1561.
- **Dependencies:** 56 native `blocked by` relations in the repository, 52 with an open blocker, no cycle.
- **Types:** 84 open issues received a GitHub issue type and the matching label. The final snapshot has 109 open issues, none without a type (Feature 56, Bug 37, Task 16).
- **Evidence comments** on existing issues #1158, #1162, #1165, #1179, #1189, #1483 and #1558.

Every write is logged with its time in `docs/case-studies/issue-1548/raw-data/github/writes/`; the helpers are in `experiments/issue-1548/`.

## Failed attempts on real issues

| Repository | Pull requests | Sessions | Files other than logs left by Formal AI | Largest classes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| link-assistant/formal-ai | 19 | 19 | 0 | "Planned, not executed" 10; three reads of a missing file 5; raw JSON as the summary 3 |
| link-assistant/hive-mind | 133 (+5 on 2026-11-10) | 135 (+5) | 0 (+2 unrelated Hello World files) | `e.g` read as a file 65; "Planned, not executed" 56 |

Each class is mapped to the issue that removes its cause (section 5 of the case study and the body of #1561). The five sessions of 2026-11-10 were started by the draft workflow of link-assistant/hive-mind on the five reports listed below; two of them committed a Hello World program to a defect report. That class had no owner, so #1562 was created. Those five draft pull requests (4036 to 4040 there) were left as they are.

The three Hello World test repositories were checked after all three runs had finished (section 4 of the case study): the Scala run stayed a draft with failing CI, the Rust run was marked ready with no checks and a compiled binary committed, the Kotlin run was marked ready with green CI and duplicate workflows. Asked again at 11:18:41Z: no later comment or push in any of the three.

## Reported to link-assistant/hive-mind

In provider-neutral words; none asks for special treatment of Formal AI.

- link-assistant/hive-mind#4031 — the restart loop on uncommitted changes never applies its "No progress" stop
- link-assistant/hive-mind#4032 — a second restart engine starts after the budget is exhausted; work stays only on a recovery branch
- link-assistant/hive-mind#4033 — the "### Changes" block of a pull request description is never refreshed (visible on this pull request before this edit)
- link-assistant/hive-mind#4034 — output-token percentage above 100%
- link-assistant/hive-mind#4035 — the prompt of a restart after a CI failure has check names only
- comments on link-assistant/hive-mind#3434 (ready for review after a failed run) and link-assistant/hive-mind#3334 (the attribution report runs only for Formal AI and walks the whole branch history)

What was not reported and why, and what was checked and refuted, is in `docs/case-studies/issue-1548/raw-data/hive-mind/reports.md`.

## Documents

| Document | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/architect-notes/2026-11-10-what-we-do-most-wrong.md` | The issue, verbatim |
| `README.md`, `docs/meta-algorithm.md` | The loop section and the page state what the recorded steps are and are not |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Pillars 2, 6, 7, 24 and 26 from Built to Partial; section "2026-11-10 Vision-Blocker Audit (issue #1548)" |
| `VISION.md`, `GOALS.md` | Section "Requirements are axioms, options are scored, the plan is executed"; one goal per new capability issue |
| `docs/configuration/solver.md` | Every solver switch with what it changes today |
| `docs/guidelines/issue-planning.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` | How issues are typed, parented and blocked, and how a failed attempt becomes an issue |
| `docs/requirements/…` | Requirements R1548-1 to R1548-19; dated measurements in doctrine rows R1001, R1002, R1010; generated documents rebuilt |
| `docs/case-studies/issue-1548/` | README, requirements, solution plan per requirement, raw data, online research |
| `changelog.d/20261110_113500_vision_blocker_audit.md` | The fragment the changelog check asks for, because the branch adds a file under `rust/tests/` |

## Requirements of the issue

All 19 rows are in `docs/case-studies/issue-1548/requirements.md`, each with its plan in `solution-plan.md`.

- **Delivered here (7):** the parent issue with native blockers (R1548-1), the vision, documents and guidelines updated (R1548-12), the three test repositories checked (R1548-13), orchestrator-side reports (R1548-15), issue types (R1548-17), the case study (R1548-18), everything in this one pull request within the scope the issue sets (R1548-19).
- **Planned here, not implemented (12):** every row that names a capability of the source — formalization and deformalization, the recursive loop, discovery with caching, tests before code, reuse of source code under its licence, inference through relative meta logic, option scoring and selection, switches, advancing the failed attempts, replacing stored solutions (R1548-2 to R1548-11, R1548-14, R1548-16). Their status in `REQUIREMENTS.md` is "Partial" and each names the issue under #1561 that owns it. These are not done by this pull request.

## Verification

- `node --test rust/tests/web/issue-1548-vision-blockers.test.mjs` — 9 tests: the verbatim note, the corrected sentences, the solver switches, every requirement with a plan, the inventories and reports, the three test repositories named letter for letter as in the issue, every open issue typed in the snapshot, the parent with 31 sub-issues and 17 blockers and no cycle, and no capability row that claims more than its plan.
- `node scripts/check-file-size.mjs`, `assemble-requirements.mjs`, `generate-requirement-status.mjs`, `check-requirement-status.mjs`, `render-status.mjs --check`, `render-progressive-plan.mjs --check`, `check-project-motto.mjs`, `check-changelog-fragment.mjs`, `bash scripts/check-secrets.sh` — pass locally.
- Rust and browser suites: CI of this pull request; nothing was compiled locally.

## Not verified

- Who authored the merged commits of pull requests #1329, #1495 and #1502, and each commit with the identity of the repository owner in the merged pull requests of link-assistant/hive-mind.
- The six agent-mode issues of 2026-10-13 (#1189, #1205, #1206, #1208, #1209, #1211) were not measured again at v0.355.34.
- Which rule selected a Hello World program for the three defect reports (recorded in #1562).
- The remaining items are listed at the end of `raw-data/hive-mind/reports.md` and `raw-data/attempts/hive-mind-attempts.md`.

## Note on size

The diff contains `dev/log/…/solve.log` (3,922 lines) committed by the draft workflow before this work began; the raw data of the case study is kept compact (snapshots on one line, one row per pull request).
title: docs: audit what blocks the vision, correct the documents, and organize the blockers under one parent issue (#1548)

## Summary

- adds a deterministic, disproof-first `FactChecker` that evaluates every statement relative to a named formal system and records tiered evidence, derivation dependencies, and JTMS invalidation
- requires explicit permission before appending general-memory facts and preserves an append-only audit trail; the current dialogue remains the default fact-checking context
- connects the behavior to the live native and WebAssembly paths in English, Russian, Hindi, and Chinese without fabricated provenance or external network dependency
- preserves the two interrupted Codex-session investigations and a reproducible fact-checking case study in the repository

## Reproduction and regression coverage

Before this change, the evidence-weighted path could retain a conclusion after one of its derivation dependencies was disproved, and the browser path had no native current-dialogue fact-check route. The new coverage reproduces those gaps and verifies:

- recursive disproof before support scoring
- prior-only claims remaining unknown
- dependency invalidation and context-relative probabilities
- permission-gated general-memory updates with append-only audit records
- native and WebAssembly current-dialogue behavior in all four supported languages
- arithmetic truth and falsehood cases without external fact-check traffic

## Verification

- focused Rust unit tests: 12 passed
- focused Rust integration tests: 3 passed
- focused Playwright issue tests: 4 passed
- stabilized long-dialog fixture load test: 8/8 passed with 8 parallel workers and no retries
- full Rust unit suite: 2,119 passed, 2 ignored
- full Rust integration suite: 241 passed with bounded local concurrency
- local browser matrix: 436 passed, 1 intentional skip; two load-sensitive tests that reached their individual 30-second limits in the sharded run passed when rerun in isolation
- `cargo fmt`, Clippy with warnings denied, rustdoc, doctests, generated-role synchronization, closure checks, self-AST checks, line budgets, version/changelog checks, and WebAssembly size checks passed
- final-SHA hosted verification: [CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/30289219029), [Agentic CLI Matrix](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/30289219018), and [Desktop Release](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/30289219979) passed
- hosted local-web matrix: 436 passed, 1 intentional skip, including the formerly load-sensitive long-dialog report test

The unsharded local browser command reached the repository-wide 900-second cutoff after 333 passing tests, so the complete local browser matrix was validated in two shards with the two isolated reruns noted above. Hosted CI independently completed the whole browser matrix in a clean environment.

## Recovery evidence

The recovered-session record links the immutable Gists and distinguishes recovered generated work from the manually reconstructed evidence:

- [recovered sessions](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/issue-845-f498587b580b/docs/case-studies/issue-845/recovered-sessions.md)
- [fact-checking case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/issue-845-f498587b580b/docs/case-studies/issue-845/README.md)

Screenshots are not applicable because this changes worker behavior and structured traces, not visual layout.

Fixes #845
title: feat: add context-relative dialogue fact checking

body:
## Summary

Fixes #1569.

This PR checks every red, yellow and misleading signal in recent CI/CD runs. Each one is classified as a false positive, false negative, warning or error. Each real defect is fixed at its root cause, with a test that reproduces it.

All collected logs, annotations, run metadata and the analysis are in [`dev/log/issues/1569/pulls/1570`](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/tree/issue-1569-fd9bc70bf432/dev/log/issues/1569/pulls/1570). Its [`README.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/issue-1569-fd9bc70bf432/dev/log/issues/1569/pulls/1570/README.md) has:
- the timeline;
- the causal chain;
- the defect register (D1–D13);
- requirement-by-requirement plans;
- the libraries considered;
- the verbose switches.

The template comparison is in [`analysis/template-comparison.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/issue-1569-fd9bc70bf432/dev/log/issues/1569/pulls/1570/analysis/template-comparison.md).

### Systemic cause

Most of the red on `main` came from gates that run **only on `main`**. Their pull requests had passed. Pull requests now run each of those regressions that needs no compiler. They run in the fast JavaScript inventory, which is now split into two longest-first groups, each with a 360 s budget. The one gate that does need a compiler (the WASM worker) gets a compiler-free input check on pull requests.

## Defects fixed

| # | Kind | Symptom | Root cause | Fix (commit) | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | false negative on PRs, error on main | `check-wasm-worker-current` red on main. The daily dependencies-latest run red. | Three merges edited worker inputs without a rebuild, and runners moved from rustc 1.99.1 to 1.100.0. dependencies-latest rebuilt the worker but never staged it. | Worker rebuilt on 1.100.0 (bytes identical to the CI artifact). `data/meta/wasm-worker-inputs.lino` and `scripts/wasm-worker-inputs.mjs --check` run on PRs, `--explain` runs on main. dependencies-latest stages the worker and its record (108db5898) | `issue-1569-wasm-worker-inputs.test.mjs`, `issue-1169-dependencies-latest-workflow.test.mjs` |
| D2 | error on main | Build and memory tests found no test binaries | Rust 1.100 build-dir v2 puts test executables under `target/<profile>/build/<pkg>/<hash>/out/` | `collect-build-artifacts.sh` uses Cargo's JSON `executable` and falls back to searching both layouts (62be90540). The native fixture runner (2c6ec5756) and the memory store (3a5d802cc, 7aca024f4) accept the new path. | `issue-1569-collect-build-artifacts.test.mjs`, `shared_memory_isolation.rs` |
| D3 | false negative | `check-ordered-lists-are-canonical` red after #1563 | A union merge produced an order that no PR had checked | 142087d2d, plus the ordered-declaration check on PRs (282a4ff4e) | `issue-1569-ordered-module-lists.test.mjs` |
| D4 | false negative | `check-generated-version-literals` red | Captured run records were not counted as evidence | 9421953d3, plus a JS twin on PRs | `issue-1569-generated-version-literals.test.mjs` |
| D5 | false negative | JS groups 4/7/8 red on main | Floors used wrong language labels, anchors were line numbers, and a capture was never counted | 4f8ecd922, 545c30b04, 2674b9663. All three suites now run on PRs. | the suites themselves |
| D6 | warning before a timeout | "still running after 270s (75% of its 360s budget)" | Moving D3–D5 onto PRs grew the single fast group | The inventory now runs in two longest-first groups (9ab8b9b27) | `fast-pull-request-production-profile.test.mjs` |
| D7 | false positive | Red `::error` annotations on green JS jobs | Hive draft tests passed `GITHUB_ACTIONS` to subprocesses that print errors on purpose | Runner variables are stripped from those subprocesses (572c558ee) | `issue-1569-test-output-annotations.test.mjs` |
| D8 | masked errors | When humaneval failed, the other nine External Benchmarks suites never ran | `set -e` inside a `for` loop | Every suite runs, each failure is annotated, and the step still fails (defe84654) | `issue-1569-workflow-failure-isolation.test.mjs` |
| D9 | false-positive cascade | 3 infrastructure failures in ladder 42472083551 failed `leaf-evidence` and all 16 composite legs | (a) composites ran under `if: always()`. (b) The sccache download returned HTTP 502/503 after its built-in retries, then the post step failed with "Unable to locate executable file: undefined". (c) `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` exited 0 without installing Bun because its download promise never settled. | (a) The composites require `leaf-evidence` success (defe84654). (b) `continue-on-error` on the sccache install, which the runner also applies to its post step; the existing #1031 probe falls back to the real compiler with a warning (also in `desktop-release.yml`). (c) A new composite, `.github/actions/setup-bun-verified`, retries once when no Bun was reported and proves the pinned `bun` runs (f378aa882). | `issue-1569-ladder-leaf-infrastructure.test.mjs` (6 cases) |
| D12 | false positive, posted on the issue | Every Hive Mind draft attempt was reported as `deferred-infrastructure`, "Hive Mind ended the attempt before solve", even though solve ran | `capture-draft-command.mjs` writes `<phase>-outcome.json`. For the `attempt` phase that is `attempt-outcome.json`, the same name #1484 gave Hive Mind's typed outcome. | Hive Mind's outcome is now read from `attempt-hive-outcome.json`, and a `draft-command-outcome/v1` capture record is never taken for one (9c5814d2e). Receipts now honestly say `serving-identity-unverified` until hive-mind#3909 lands. | `hive-draft-attempt-identity.test.mjs` "the capture record of the attempt phase is never read as a Hive Mind outcome". It fails on the old library. |

Defects this PR's own CI caught and fixed:
- the abbreviation ratchet on the new layout helper (7aca024f4);
- the D6 budget warning;
- the D7 annotations on the PR run.

## Documented, not changed (with reasons)

- **D10: HumanEval 12/20.** A real capability regression between `efb6ddb6` and `d209aac6`, not a CI defect. D8 had hidden the other suites, and with D8 fixed every suite now reports.
- **D11: job headroom.** The headroom warnings are true measurements. Per the CI speed policy, the fix is to repartition the work, not to raise timeouts. D6 covers the JS tier. The 1200 s ladder budget needs its own issue.
- **D13: the work-item `docker pull` cap.** Already fixed on main by 066cffea2 (#1541).
- **The other 32 `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` uses (18 workflows).** They carry the same latent hazard, but it has been observed only once. Some of those workflows have tests that pin their `uses:` lines, and `release.yml` and the generated `release-staged.yml` are out of bounds. The composite is a drop-in replacement.
- **SHA-pinning of actions** (the template practice). This repository deliberately uses tag pins under its zizmor policy, and the change would cover the whole repository.
- **Eleven file-size advisories** (`scripts/check-file-size.mjs`, warning at 1400 lines, hard limit at 1500). They name ten seed and `ts/` files. These are true warnings: every count is the same on main, and this PR touches none of those files. Splitting them is a content refactor for their owners.
- **Hive Mind draft job conclusion.** Red when there is no unique candidate (`gap-no-unique-candidate`), by design.
- **Checked and found clean:** runner-image notices, the crates.io token "UNKNOWN", the vsce bundle advice, historical phase-timing warnings, the intended #1031 sccache fallback warnings, cache notices, and actionlint on the touched workflows.

## Template comparison and upstream reports

I compared the files, workflows and scripts of the rust, js, python, php, csharp, java, cpp and go `link-foundation/*-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template` repositories. The Rust template is not affected by D2. I filed the following issues, each with a reproduction, a workaround and a suggested change:

- rust: link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template#249 (Pages deploys only on push, so a PR is green and main is red)
- php: link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template#25 (same, plus `configure-pages` inside the build job)
- csharp: link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template#110 (the Codecov token check runs only on main)
- java: link-foundation/java-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template#29 (no aggregate pipeline-status job)
- go: link-foundation/go-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template#17 (no `timeout-minutes` on the release jobs)

I found no verified defect in js, python or cpp.

## Debug output (off by default)

- `FORMAL_AI_CI_VERBOSE=true` (repository variable): sccache server debug log.
- `node scripts/wasm-worker-inputs.mjs --explain`: runs only when the main wasm gate fails, and names the input or the compiler that changed.
- The sccache warning now names a failed install.

## How to reproduce and verify

- D1: `node scripts/wasm-worker-inputs.mjs --check` fails when a worker input is edited without `--write` and a rebuild.
- D9: `node --test rust/tests/web/issue-1569-ladder-leaf-infrastructure.test.mjs`
- D12: `node --test rust/tests/web/hive-draft-attempt-identity.test.mjs`. With the old `FILES.hiveOutcome = 'attempt-outcome.json'`, the new case fails.
- I ran the relevant JS tests locally, one at a time, along with `translate-js-rust --verify`, `documentation-only-ci-policy`, `check-readable-code` and the abbreviation ratchet. CI on this branch is green, and the ladder runs only on main.

The changelog fragment is `changelog.d/20261115_150000_ci_false_negatives.md` (patch).
title: fix(ci): remove CI/CD false positives, false negatives, warnings and errors (#1569)

body:
Explicit combined-total questions could fall through to a prose-calculation error or an unrelated unit conversion. Add a seeded, fully consumed quantity/comparison frame that retains the raw question and UTF-8 spans and delegates arithmetic to existing calculators. Owned unsupported constraints decline; unrelated aggregate-concept questions keep their existing route.

Quantity logic has its own worker and checker-generated initial budget. Legacy arithmetic stays at 784 lines with its existing ceiling. Maintained generators refresh TypeScript, the worker factory/inventory, seed mirrors and debug-source mapping. Five explicit producer event kinds preserve computed frames, verdicts and declines through the server projection.

The CI follow-up also regenerates the status surface, uses hyphenated canonical seed symbols while preserving public intents/event kinds, and refreshes the complete governed source registry/witness after module registration. No notation ceiling, source assertion or case inventory is weakened. The explicit hosted target uses the committed Bun lock, checks source inputs against Git blobs, and exports only bounded source artifacts.

Validation:

- Maintained whole-JavaScript QA: 23/23, including the naming repair. Selected server-evidence cases: 2/2 (seven other cases filtered). The selected local debug owner/excerpt assertion passed; the full local file was blocked by an unselected HTTP fixture hook.
- Seven authored Rust tests cover 18 shared vectors and additional arithmetic, UTF-8, ownership and unsafe-operand controls. Native compile, lint and execution remain pending CI; no local Rust/WASM execution occurred.
- [Earlier hosted translation](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/41791832746) reproduced three actual translations and retained ledger/blocker counts.
- [Complete hosted source regeneration](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/41801955660) was independently imported without executing generated code or reserializing the witness.
